correctness.rationale: The defining square-zero and pairwise anticommutation equations on generator images reduce exactly to an alternating ΦV in odd characteristic; fixed rank r gives alternating forms on source/kerV (dimension r(r−1)/2), arbitrary Φ extensions (dimension m(3−r)), and free cubic coefficients (dimension m). Rank-r base is smooth irreducible dimension r(3+m−r); for m>=3 ranks 2 and 3 both have dimension 4m+3 and yield distinct full-dimensional component closures. Counting rank-r matrices gives the claimed finite-field formula. In characteristic two the augmentation ideal consists of square-zero elements and is commutative, yielding affine dimension 7m. Literal exterior multiplication was exhaustively checked in all declared finite cases and the canonical rank fibers.

value.rationale: Hom(E_m,E3) with ranks of the induced augmentation-quotient map is a canonical algebraic moduli object; exact finite-field rank-strata counts over all odd fields and arbitrary m determine genuine arithmetic invariants beyond the known invertible case. The equal-dimensional rank-two and rank-three irreducible loci give distinct top-dimensional reduced components, and characteristic two changes the full geometry to an affine space. Not an arbitrary small-n table or relabeling.
